339-677-4742-7272.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
339-677-4742-7272.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Jegantha, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2023-3480-4518-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

529-4785-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

3227-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
3227-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scrivener and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
3227-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scrivener and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

222-527-4247-4460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-4247-4460.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1445-3899-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3899-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-5662-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Reyhan.
When Reyhan dies, its persist ability and innate ability trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Reyhan from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the innate trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on a creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

222-527-2511-7296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-2511-7296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1322-2366-3512-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1322-2366-3512-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mana Flare triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

225-539-3861-6628.description:
Activate PuPu UFO by tapping it, putting Orzhov Basilica from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping PuPu UFO as it is a land due to Ashaya.
Repeat.

457-5078-5390-5705.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {1}.
Glaring Fleshraker and Forensic Gadgeteer's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Glaring Fleshraker trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Forensic Gadgeteer trigger, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Pakpatiq, Deepest Epoch // Temple of Cyclical Time

5550-5551-6797.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
5550-5551-6797.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Pakpatiq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat from step 4.

101-1987-2556-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
101-1987-2556-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mnemonic Wall and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Mnemonic Wall and Vampire Charmseeker enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-2556-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

5544-5670-6094.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
5544-5670-6094.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Forsaken Miner.
When Forsaken Miner dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, targeting an opponent.
Forsaken Miner triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch ability, causing you to gain 1 life and causing an opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1061-1576-3557.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} the first turn, with {3}{U}{U}{U} available each extra turn
1061-1576-3557.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness. An opponent cannot block Brago.
You have the city's blessing.
You have an effect that grants Timestream Navigator haste each turn.
1061-1576-3557.description:
Activate Timestream Navigator by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping and putting it on the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Forerunner of the Coalition. and any number of other nonland permanents you control.
Forerunner of the Coalition enters, triggering its first ability, causing you to search your library for Timestream Navigator and put it on top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Timestream Navigator during your draw phase.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.
Timestream Navigator enters the battlefield, triggering Forerunner of the Coalition's second ability, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.
1061-1576-3557.notes: This loop will only continue as long as you can deal combat damage to an opponent with Brago.

2129-5342.notablePrerequisites: Scytheclaw attached to a creature you control that can attack this turn and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2129-5342.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Scytheclaw attached.
Scytheclaw's second ability triggers, causing the defending opponent to lose their entire life total due to Bloodletter of Aclazotz.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

575-2690-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Rattleclaw Mystic.
When Rattleclaw Mystic dies, Yedora triggers, returning Rattleclaw Mystic from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Rattleclaw Mystic's power.
Activate Rattleclaw Mystic's morph ability by paying {2}, turning it face up.
Rattleclaw Mystic triggers, adding {G}{U}{R}.
Repeat.

1144-4180-5158.description:
Yavimaya causes all lands to be Forests in addition to their other types, thus Living Lands causes all lands to be 1/1 creatures.
Because Elesh Norn gives all creatures your opponents control -2/-2, they die as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.
Whenever an opponent plays a land, it will also die as a state-based action.

3525-4474-4639.notablePrerequisites: Paradise Mantle and Pemmin's Aura attached to the same blue creature without summoning sickness.
3525-4474-4639.description:
Activate the creature with Paradise Mantle and Pemmin's Aura attached by tapping it, adding {U}.
The creature triggers, causing you to loot.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping the creature.
Repeat.

385-2106-3652-4763.notablePrerequisites:
Mortarpod attached to Ornithopter.
Fighter Class is at least level two.
385-2106-3652-4763.description:
Activate Ornithopter by sacrificing it.
Ornithopter dies, triggering Koll, returning Ornithopter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ornithopter ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Activate Mortarpod's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Ornithopter.
Repeat.

2060-2710-3233-4120.description:
Cast Saving Grace by paying {1}{W}.
Saving Grace enters the battlefield attached to Crystalline Crawler, triggering itself, causing all damage that would be dealt to you or permanents you control this turn to be dealt to Crystalline Crawler instead.
Activate Ashen Firebeast by paying {1}{R}, dealing 1 damage to each creature without flying.
Saving Grace's ability redirects damage to Crystalline Crawler, which results in at least three +1/+1 counters being placed on it instead due to Vigor.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first activated ability at least twice by removing at least two +1/+1 counters from it, adding at least {1}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.
